description: Water Production, Abstraction, Losses and Uses is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. Annual water balance for the State of Qatar (million m3/year): system volume input (mainly desalinated water), real losses, authorised consumption, groundwater abstraction by well type, reuse of treated sewage water by purpose, water demand, and total net water used. Data cover 2009-2023. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are desalination, groundwater. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-07-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water resources and water supply network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
